notif.title: Notifications
notif.application: An application is waiting for review

checkin.title: Weekly check-in
checkin.subtitle: One form per student, every week, whether the lesson happened or not.
checkin.subtitlestudent: Fill this in every week, whether the lesson happened or not.
checkin.week: Which week are you filling in?
checkin.happened: Did the lesson happen this week?
checkin.happenedstudent: Did you and your teacher have a lesson?
checkin.perstudent: A separate form for each student — lesson lengths and reasons differ.

auth.title: Sign in to your portal
auth.subtitle: Sign in with the email and password you registered with.
auth.wrong: That email and password do not match an account on this portal.
auth.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.taken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.invalid: Check the name, the email and a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.name: Full name
auth.pitch: Attendance and announcements — the whole programme at a glance.

403.body: You don’t have access to this page. Sign in with an account that does, or go back to your portal.

404.body: We can’t find the page you’re looking for. It may have moved, or the link that brought you here is out of date.

tutor.confidential: Reports are confidential and visible only to the safeguarding team.
tutor.noanswer: No written answer — see the attached work.

vocab.title: Personal vocabulary bank
vocab.subtitle: Highlight any new word in a lesson or homework and save it to My cards — quizzes build themselves.
vocab.adddesc: Type a word yourself, or highlight it on the learning and assignments pages.
vocab.capturehint: Add the meaning, then save it to your cards.
vocab.quizidle: Start a quick quiz built from the words you saved yourself.

res.title: Lesson resource library
res.subtitle: Filter by level, skill and bandwidth.

comms.title: Announcements
comms.subtitle: Write once in English and Arabic, send to a segment.
comms.subject: Subject

training.title: Student training
training.subtitle: Eight units to work through before your lessons start.
training.lockeddesc: Finish the unit before this one to open it.
training.soondesc: The content for this unit is still being prepared. You will be told as soon as it opens.
training.finishhint: Complete everything marked required to finish the unit.
training.remaining: The remaining units are being prepared and will open later.
training.submitdesc: Every unit that is open is finished. Send your results to the admissions team to complete your conditional offer.
training.submitteddesc: The admissions team has your unit results and every answer you gave. They will be in touch by email.
training.blocked: Finish every open unit to send your training.

exam.readytosend: All questions answered — you can submit.
exam.done: Thank you for completing the Diagnostic Exam
exam.donedesc: Please complete the rest of the training. Your answers go to the admissions team, who will place you at the right level — there is no score to see here.
exam.oncenote: This exam can only be answered once

hw.newdesc: It was attached to one of your lessons — open it and start when you can.
hw.awaitingnote: Sent. Your teacher will grade it soon.
hw.emptystudent: No homework yet — your teacher attaches it after a lesson.
hw.promptdesc: Attach it now, or open the lesson later and add it then.
hw.none: Nothing attached to this lesson yet
hw.title: Homework title
hw.instructionsph: Write the task in a line or two — or leave it to the file.
hw.filehint: PDF, image or audio. You can attach more than one.
hw.sent: Homework attached — the student has been notified
hw.needtitle: Give the homework a title first

lesson.title: Lessons & homework
lesson.subtitle: Every week you have taught — open a lesson to see it and attach homework.
lesson.pick: Pick a lesson to open it.

apply.subtitle: Finish the training below and send it for review. The rest of the portal opens once it is approved.
apply.sent: Sent — an admin will review your training
apply.pendingtitle: Your training is with an admin
apply.pendingbody: You will be told as soon as it is reviewed. Nothing else to do for now.
apply.pendingbodyteacher: Your teacher account was sent for review when you registered. You will be told as soon as an admin has looked at it.
apply.approvedbody: Everything in the portal is yours now.
apply.rejectedbody: Read the reason below, put it right, and send it again.
apply.waitingsubtitle: An admin reviews every new account before it opens.

intake.title: Application intake
intake.subtitle: Control whether trainees can send their units to admissions.
intake.opendesc: Anyone who has finished their units can send them, and new applications reach the review queue.
intake.closeddesc: Nobody can send their units right now. Trainees keep working through them and their results are kept until you open intake again.
intake.messagehint: Every student sees this on their training page while intake is closed, in place of the send button. Write it in at least one language — leave both empty and a default text is shown.
intake.nomessage: No message — the default text will be shown.

review.title: Accounts & applications
review.subtitle: Approve new accounts, and suspend the ones that must stop.
review.reasonhint: The applicant reads this, so say what to fix.
review.newadminhint: Operations accounts are opened only from here, by an admin who is already signed in.
review.created: Account created — they can sign in now
review.notraining: This applicant has not started the training yet.
review.placementnote: The placement test is not marked — its answers are used to place the student at the right level.

suspend.title: Your account is suspended
suspend.body: An admin has stopped this account, so nothing in the portal is open to you right now.
suspend.contact: Contact the admin team for the details: admin@paperairplanes.org

sem.title: Semester
sem.subtitle: Set the first and last day — the weeks are created from them automatically.
sem.notstarted: The semester has not started yet
sem.edithint: Correct the name or dates of the current semester. Weeks are counted from the first day, and forms already sent keep their week number.
sem.newhint: Week numbers start again from 1. Forms from the current semester stay saved, but students and teachers no longer see them.
sem.baddates: The last day must come after the first day.
sem.toolong: A semester can be 52 weeks at most.

att.title: Weekly check-ins
att.subtitle: Students and teachers each send their own form. Once sent, only an admin can change it.

sched.joinsoon: The join button opens 15 minutes before the session starts.
sched.nolink: Your teacher hasn't added the meeting link yet.
sched.nolinkteacher: This session has no meeting link — add one to the student's schedule.
sched.formwaits: The form opens when this week's session ends —
sched.prefilled: Filled in from this week's sessions. Check the answers and correct anything that differs before you send.
sched.title: Session schedule
sched.subtitle: One weekly session per student, plus any extra or make-up sessions
sched.linkhint: Students never see the link itself — they join through the portal's button.
sched.schedulehint: The session repeats every week from the first date until the semester ends. Changing the schedule moves the sessions that haven't started yet.
sched.removeconfirm: Remove this schedule and its upcoming sessions?
sched.cancelconfirm: Cancel this session? The student will see it as cancelled.
sched.badlink: Enter a full https link, for example https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
sched.outside: That date is outside the current semester.
